groups.description: Models within this group: Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro
Models within this group: Claude Opus, Claude Sonnet, GPT-OSS
For paid Pro plans, Argon quota is separate. Higher Argon quota (included as part of the larger Gemini quota bucket) is available on Ultra plans.

daily.description: Within each group, models share a weekly limit and a 5-hour limit. Quota is consumed proportionally to the cost of the tokens. Thus, limits will last longer with shorter tasks or using more cost-effective models. The 5-hour limit smooths out aggregate demand to fairly distribute global capacity across all users, while your weekly limit is tied directly to your individual tier.
